# Shivansi Restaurant & Sweet Shop — LLM Context

> This file provides structured context for AI language models and crawlers
> about the Shivansi web application. Last updated: 2026-08-25.

## What Is This?

**Shivansi Restaurant & Sweet Shop** is a full-stack restaurant management web application
built for a physical restaurant in Ranchi, India. Customers scan a QR code at their table
and order food directly from their phone — no app download required.

- **Production URL**: https://shivansi.in
- **Tech Stack**: React 19 · TanStack Start (SSR) · TanStack Router · Supabase (Auth + DB) · Tailwind CSS v4
- **Runtime**: Cloudflare Workers (via Nitro)
- **Design System**: Dark glassmorphism / aurora gradient aesthetic with oklch color tokens

## Primary User Flows

1. **Customer Order Flow**: `/` → `/table/:tableNumber` → `/menu` → `/cart` → `/my-orders`
2. **Admin Dashboard**: `/admin` (email + password auth required)
3. **Authentication**: `/auth` (phone OTP for customers, email/password for admin)

## Key Pages & Routes

| Route | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/` | Homepage — hero, today's special, popular items, festival offers |
| `/menu` | Full menu with category filters, veg/non-veg filter, search |
| `/table/:tableNumber` | QR landing — sets table context in session |
| `/cart` | Cart review, cooking instructions, UPI/Cash payment selection |
| `/my-orders` | Live order tracking with real-time status updates |
| `/order/:orderId` | Single order detail with status timeline |
| `/auth` | Phone OTP login for customers |
| `/admin` | Owner dashboard (revenue, orders, analytics) |
| `/admin/menu` | CRUD for categories and dishes |
| `/admin/tables` | Table management + QR code generation |
| `/admin/offers` | Festival offers & discount campaigns |
| `/admin/customers` | Customer list with loyalty & reward points |
| `/admin/inventory` | Ingredient stock management |
| `/admin/reports` | Revenue / profit analytics |
| `/admin/settings` | Restaurant profile, GST, UPI, hours |

## Data Model Summary

- **products** — menu items with price, images, category, veg flag, availability
- **categories** — ordered list of menu sections
- **orders** — customer orders linked to table + session
- **order_items** — line items per order
- **profiles** — customer accounts (phone OTP-based)
- **tables** — restaurant tables with QR mapping
- **offers** — festival discount campaigns with coupon codes
- **inventory** — ingredient stock levels

## Architecture Notes

- SSR via TanStack Start + Nitro (Cloudflare target)
- Auth managed by Supabase; session tokens stored in secure HTTP-only cookies
- Real-time order status via Supabase Realtime subscriptions
- All public-facing UI routes are fully accessible without login (guest ordering supported)
- Admin routes are protected by Supabase RLS + server-side session checks

## Contact / Business

- **Cuisine**: North Indian, Sweets, Snacks, Breakfast
- **Location**: Ranchi, Jharkhand, India
- **Primary Language**: English (UI), Hindi (menu items)
